description: Whole-turn evaluation: did a message in the language Account Managers actually use reach the right capability, identify the right service, and carry the right facts? 'expect' capabilities must all be planned and 'forbid' must not be — but capability assertions only prove the plumbing routes. 'expectItem', 'expectVerdict' and 'expectOutcome' are what test the product: they assert what the resolver actually decided, so a request cannot be answered from the wrong catalogue item and still score green. Assert the item where it is unambiguous, the verdict wherever one should be stated, and the outcome where the correct behaviour is to ask or to name no service at all. Cases marked 'critical' are ones where a wrong answer misleads someone about safety or about money: any failure there fails the run.

cases.message: can we do merch for the london branch
billboards?
is audience segmentation included
who looks after our instagram posts
cases.knownFailure: Corpus gap, not a ranking defect. 'Instagram' appears in zero documents, as do Twitter and YouTube; the organic social items never name the platforms they cover, so the request has no distinctive word to match and the resolver correctly declines. Fixed by naming the platforms as aliases - see T26.
cases.note: Every item in Organic social media is Local, so the verdict is certain even though the exact item is arguable. Answering in_scope tells an AM central marketing owns work the local team does.

cases.knownFailure: Passes in the deployed configuration and fails offline. Telling a genuine second reading of a request from a coincidental shared word is a question about meaning, and keyword scoring cannot answer it: across these cases genuine disagreement measures 0.77-0.99 of the leader's confidence and a pure coincidence 0.79, which no threshold separates. With embeddings the same cases measure 0.88-1.00 against 0.69. Recorded rather than tuned away, because the offline mode is a fallback and asking too often is its safe failure direction.
cases.note: A vague pricing question must not settle on a service. Agreeing on the video items answers 'included, free of charge' to a question about cost.

cases.message: Can we see this month's SEO report?
Can we set up a 1:1 monthly call between our GM and the marketing team?
cases.knownFailure: Corpus gap, not a ranking defect. The item is named 'Marketing + GMs calls - 121', and no phrasing a person uses reaches it: '1:1' tokenises to ('1','1') and 'one to one' to nothing at all, because 'one' is a stopword. Fixed by declaring '1:1', 'one to one' and 'one-to-one' as aliases on the Scope sheet - see T25.
cases.note: 'GM' names this item outright. The rival call items are in scope, so a clarification here risks promising a call the retainer does not cover.
